inputs.checklistItemText: Trees not shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities, preventing clearance verification
inputs.question: Are both the proposed trees (via SY, PL, P, M symbols) AND the overhead electric (OHE) lines shown together on the landscape plan so that their spatial relationship and clearances can be verified? Are clearance dimensions or clearance zone notes annotated on the landscape plan where trees are near OHE?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether both trees and OHE lines are present together on the landscape plan AND whether clearance annotations exist—this is a presence/annotation check (sheet content verification), not a measurement of actual clearance distance between specific features.
